name: AGC-003 — Credential-Harvesting Link Click
description: Manual Execution & Real Telemetry (Phase 2) by Ali (TOOSHY2). | AGC-003: Spearphishing lure impersonating IT Helpdesk (helpdesk@ashfordgrove.local) delivers credential-harvesting link (10.10.40.10/portal-login). Cleartext AD credentials captured on wire via tcpdump, confirmed in attacker persistent logs, validated in Zeek http.log (POST /login), permitted via OPNsense LAN pass rule, and correlated in Wazuh SIEM. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: Critical.

techniques.comment: AGC-003: Spearphishing link via helpdesk@ashfordgrove.local. Target michael.chen browsed to http://10.10.40.10/portal-login and entered AD credentials. Cleartext capture confirmed via live tcpdump sniffer and captured-creds.log. Triangulated in Zeek (POST /login) and OPNsense (P14-RuleA). Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: Critical.
AGC-003: Web portal credential harvesting. Fake Acme Corp Single Sign-On portal captured corporate email and password via unencrypted HTTP POST. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: Critical.
